headline: Google’s free streaming service now lets you pick shows and movies to watch
summary: Google TV Freeplay now offers video on demand. Users can choose from over 10,000 shows and movies. This expands beyond its previous always-on channels.

headline: Another OpenAI executive takes off
summary: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI's special projects lead and former COO, has departed the company. He announced his exit after an eight-year tenure. Lightcap plans to start "something new."

headline: The budget-friendly Pixel Buds 2a are even cheaper right now
summary: Google Pixel Buds 2a are currently discounted to $99 from $129. These earbuds are ideal for Android phones. They offer a lightweight fit and come in four colors.

headline: Google’s upcoming Pixel phones are for the fans, even if its launch event isn’t
summary: Google's new Pixel phones are designed to appeal to power users. This year's launch event is expected to be more technical. Fans anticipate specific features like a notification LED.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: LEGO Bonsai Trees, Borderlands 4 for PS5, and Switch 2 MicroSD Express Cards
summary: Discover top deals on LEGO Bonsai Trees. Find Borderlands 4 for PS5 among today's offers. Also featured are Switch 2 MicroSD Express Cards.

headline: Bethesda Finally Confirms The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered Patch Is Coming
summary: Bethesda confirmed a patch is coming for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered. The announcement follows the Nintendo Switch 2 version's release. No specific release date for the patch was provided.

headline: Nvidia's Price Increases Are Live, As RTX 5060 Ti Jumps to Over $800
summary: Nvidia's new price increases have officially gone live. The RTX 5060 Ti graphics card now costs over $800. This impacts PC builders and gamers looking for new hardware.

headline: More Lord of the Rings Remasters Are in the Works Following War in the North Re-Release, Confirms Aspyr
summary: Aspyr confirms plans for more Lord of the Rings game remasters. This follows the recent re-release of War in the North. Further details on specific titles are awaited.

headline: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
summary: The Met Office predicts Summer 2026 will be the UK's hottest on record. Only average August conditions are needed to break last year's record. This highlights a continuing trend of rising temperatures.

headline: Burnham 'confident' early release of PC Harper's killers can be halted
summary: The Prime Minister is confident in halting early releases for serious offenders. The justice secretary will present a plan in September. This addresses public concern over such cases as PC Harper's killers.

headline: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
summary: Demand for specialist eclipse glasses has surged. Stocks are nearly sold out online across the UK. This is ahead of the country's most significant eclipse since 1999.

headline: Watch: Was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
summary: US media reports suggest Trump secretly left Air Force One via a catering truck. This was reportedly to avoid a life threat from Iran. The BBC provides a video for viewers to watch.
